title: 场景卡写明汇总字段立场：看不到明细的角色，汇总数也要屏蔽
body:
epic:#5027#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMUfmNYTem26rXLFUf

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Maintainer ruling 2026-11-27 01:42Z (decision card in the seat thread): 「客户角色能不能看到项目的任务数和总工时这类汇总数？」→「不能看，按明细权限屏蔽」.
Parent: objectstack-ai/cloud#5027 (M2 Build line). Source: objectstack-ai/cloud#5080 item B (comment https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/5080#issuecomment-7207375342). Pairs with objectstack#37757 (the door reports the roll-up advisory on save).
Grading: area:ai · domain:devx · Task · p2 · size XS · reach: every scenario round on `project_with_tasks` and `invoice_with_line_items`.
Dedupe: searched `allowedRollups`, `roll-up persona line`: none open.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：你定了「看不到明细的角色，汇总数也不能看」。评分一直按这个扣分，但卡片和提示词没告诉智能体，它只能猜。
- 做法：在两张卡给智能体的角色说明里写明这条，评分不变。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What to do
1. `packages/qa/scenarios` `personaLine()` (or the two cards' persona text): for a persona that is denied a child object, say that roll-up fields summarising that child (`project.task_count`, `project.total_estimate` for `client_viewer`; `invoice.total` for `warehouse_staff`) are withheld from it too.
2. Keep the scorer as it is (it already charges a granted roll-up over withheld children). Do not add `allowedRollups` to these personas.
3. Every other card's prompt stays byte-identical; show the prompt diff in the PR.
4. Test: the two cards' prompts carry the sentence; one unrelated card is unchanged.
